name: Parson's Close Recreation Ground Inclusive Play Area
description: Fully inclusive adventure play area, refurbished in 2022 and awarded PiPA Gold, in a Green Flag park behind the town centre. The free Splash and Play and a 20 m sand beach are usually open from late May to the end of September; there's also a skate park, table tennis, a café and toilets including a Changing Places toilet. No parking at the park: use Duncombe Drive car park (LU7 1SD).
